product_summary: A mobile application that enables customers to browse local restaurants, place food orders, track their delivery in real-time, and provide feedback on their experience.
problem_statement: Customers often face inconvenience when ordering food, including limited options, lack of real-time tracking, and difficulty providing feedback, leading to frustration and uncertainty about their orders.
modules: Backend Services (API Gateway, Order Management, User Management, Restaurant Management, Delivery Management, Payment Gateway Integration, Notification Service)
possible_apis: Mapping/Location Services API (e.g., Google Maps, Mapbox)
Push Notification Service API (e.g., Firebase Cloud Messaging)
functional_requirements: FR1: The system shall allow customers to register and log in securely.
FR2: The system shall display a list of available restaurants based on the customer's location.
FR3: The system shall allow customers to browse restaurant menus and view item details.
FR4: The system shall enable customers to add/remove items to/from a shopping cart.
FR5: The system shall allow customers to place an order, specifying delivery address and payment method.
FR6: The system shall process payments securely.
FR7: The system shall provide real-time updates on order status (e.g., "Order Placed", "Preparing", "Out for Delivery", "Delivered").
FR8: The system shall allow customers to track the delivery driver's location on a map.
FR9: The system shall enable customers to submit ratings and reviews for restaurants and delivery experiences.
FR10: The system shall allow restaurants to receive, accept, and manage incoming orders.
FR11: The system shall allow delivery drivers to accept delivery requests and update delivery status.
FR12: The system shall send notifications to customers, restaurants, and drivers regarding order updates.
non_functional_requirements: NFR1: The application shall be available 99.9% of the time.
NFR2: The system shall process customer orders within 5 seconds.
NFR3: The system shall handle a minimum of 1000 concurrent orders.
NFR4: All sensitive customer and payment data shall be encrypted both in transit and at rest.
NFR5: The user interface shall be intuitive and easy to navigate for all user roles.
NFR6: The mobile applications shall be compatible with iOS and Android platforms.
NFR7: The system shall be scalable to accommodate future growth in users and orders.
constraints: C1: Initial launch limited to a specific geographic region/city.
C2: Must integrate with at least one major payment gateway.
C3: Development timeline for MVP is 3 months.
C4: Budget limitations for third-party API usage.
assumptions: A1: Customers have access to smartphones and internet connectivity.
A2: Restaurants have internet access and a device to manage orders.
A3: Delivery drivers own smartphones and have data plans.
A4: Legal and regulatory requirements for food delivery services are understood and will be adhered to.
A5: A sufficient number of restaurants and delivery drivers will onboard to the platform.
